change.request: Correct the request option handling so fetch-only dispatcher options are preserved when creating and sending requests.

unknowns: Whether every supported runtime accepts dispatcher and priority directly on fetch() without a Request-constructor path.

risks.rationale: Removing dispatcher and priority from the request registry changes which options are forwarded separately to fetch and could alter runtime behavior.

evidenceNotes.claim: The request-option registry marks dispatcher and priority as RequestInit fields, which is why they never reach fetch separately.
evidenceNotes.evidence: requestOptionsRegistry lists dispatcher and priority next to method, headers, and signal and is typed as RequestInitRegistry.

evidenceNotes.claim: Ky computes the separate fetch options from the registry before calling the configured fetch function.
evidenceNotes.evidence: _fetch calls findUnknownOptions(this.request, this._options) and passes the result to this._options.fetch or timeout().

evidenceNotes.claim: The regression is covered by the fetch test suite.
evidenceNotes.evidence: test/fetch.ts exercises option forwarding to the fetch implementation and is the suite changed alongside the fix.
